summary: Strudel REPL operator that creates a DOM container for the Strudel REPL editor and outputs the container element, audio node, and note telemetry details for downstream use in cables patches.

ports.name: Show UI
ports.text: Toggle visibility of the Strudel REPL editor container.

ports.name: Play / Stop
ports.text: Toggle to evaluate (play) or stop the pattern.

ports.name: Width
ports.text: Width of the editor container.

ports.name: Height
ports.text: Height of the editor container.

ports.name: Position X
ports.text: X position offset of the container on the screen.

ports.name: Position Y
ports.text: Y position offset of the container on the screen.

ports.name: Opacity
ports.text: Opacity of the container.

ports.name: Strudel CSS Variables
ports.text: Custom CSS variables to style the Strudel REPL editor.

ports.name: Pattern Code
ports.text: Strudel pattern code to evaluate.

ports.name: Enable Telemetry
ports.text: Checkbox to enable or disable gathering note-level telemetry outputs to save CPU cycles.

ports.name: Volume
ports.text: Master volume multiplier for the output GainNode.

ports.name: Popup Sound Output
ports.text: Toggle whether Strudel audio is sent directly to the device speakers (true) or muted so it only outputs through Cables WebAudio (false).

ports.name: Element
ports.text: The mounted DOM container element.

ports.name: Audio Node
ports.text: The WebAudio GainNode forwarding Strudel's audio output.

ports.name: Current Pattern
ports.text: The code text currently typed into the Strudel editor.

ports.name: Is Playing
ports.text: Boolean output stating whether Strudel is actively playing a pattern.

ports.name: Active Notes
ports.text: Array of active note event telemetry details currently playing.

ports.name: Active MIDI Notes
ports.text: Array of MIDI note numbers of currently active notes.

ports.name: Active Note Names
ports.text: Array of note names (e.g. ['C4', 'E4']) of currently active notes.

ports.name: Active Note Count
ports.text: Number of currently active notes.

ports.name: On Note Event
ports.text: Trigger fired whenever a note event starts.

ports.name: CPS
ports.text: Current cycles per second (tempo).

ports.name: BPM
ports.text: Current beats per minute (tempo).

ports.name: Cycle Progress
ports.text: Current phase progress (0.0 - 1.0) inside the active cycle.

ports.name: Current Cycle
ports.text: Total cycle index elapsed.

ports.name: On Cycle
ports.text: Trigger fired at the start of each new cycle.

ports.name: Last Event
ports.text: The event object of the last triggered hap note.

ports.name: Last Sound
ports.text: The sound bank name of the last triggered note.

ports.name: Error
ports.text: Syntax or evaluation error message string if Strudel code fails compile.
